articles.title: OpenAI rules out IPO this year as Altman, Musk & Amodei warn AI is moving too fast
articles.description: Altman's IPO comments and Amodei's public call for more careful pacing of AI development cap a week of loud AI warnings.

articles.title: OpenAI IPO won't happen this year, says Sam Altman
articles.description: "Given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public," OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told Fortune.

articles.title: Bitcoin Suisse plans to cut up to half its Swiss jobs as it shifts work abroad
articles.description: The company is closing its Copenhagen IT site while maintaining Bratislava and opening a new hub in Vietnam to reduce costs.

articles.title: Nigel Farage’s Reform UK lands $97 million donations from two crypto billionaires in 24 hours
articles.description: The combined haul equals the largest individual political donations in U.K. history, sharply scaling up crypto industry backing.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI race to slow down citing safety. Musk and OpenAI's Altman agrees
articles.description: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed on an unusual position: frontier AI development may need to slow as systems become capable of helping build their own successors.

articles.title: Conversations that AIs are having in the office that may influence your performance review and pay
articles.description: AI tools can help find the right tone and language for difficult workplace conversations about performance and pay, and managers are already using them.

articles.title: Larry Ellison nixes plan to offload up to $7.5 billion worth of Oracle stock
articles.description: Oracle founder Larry Ellison has canceled his plan to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of stock in the software company.

articles.title: Revolut Leaks Passports, Bitcoin Transaction Histories to Fake Government Request
articles.description: The fintech company fulfilled a fraudulent information request sent from a government agency's own email domain, exposing ID documents and full crypto transaction histories for a "limited" number of users.

articles.title: GPT-6 Astra Users Say OpenAI's Newest Model Got Dumber. It Happened Before, Too
articles.description: A week after launch, complaints are rolling in from users that GPT-6 Astra has been nerfed. OpenAI's last model went through the same cycle in July.

articles.title: Ripple stablecoin chief sees $13 trillion corporate treasury opportunity for RLUSD
articles.description: Payments and capital markets are driving growth for Ripple's $2.4 billion digital dollar as it looks to bring RLUSD to Europe under MiCA, the firm's Jack McDonald said.

articles.title: Ditching bonds for bitcoin: How crypto can tackle the AI-heavy portfolio dilemma
articles.description: Bitcoin Suisse says rising AI investment, government debt and weakening stock-bond diversification strengthen the case for adding bitcoin to traditional portfolios.

articles.title: Crypto Billionaires Hand Reform UK $97M in Record Donations
articles.description: Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne each gave £36 million, and between them beat what every UK party raised last year.

articles.title: GTA Mod Adds Flock Cameras—And Lets Players Destroy Them
articles.description: The surveillance mod on GTA V brings the privacy fight to Los Santos, where players can demolish the cameras tracking them.

articles.title: Stocks stumble on inflation fears, but 2 of our names give us reasons to stay bullish
articles.description: Stocks came under pressure last week as surging oil prices and bond yields stoked renewed concerns about inflation and the Fed's next move.

articles.title: Staked ether should be seen as the benchmark of the decentralized economy
articles.description: The yield-generating asset has a special place in the digital asset investor’s portfolio, argues GlobalStake’s Ryan Haczynski.

articles.title: Construction robots are tackling America's housing shortage, but we're a long way from humanoid homebuilders
articles.description: America's housing market is short inventory and workers, pressuring home affordability. Constructions robots are reality, but to date not humanoid homebuilders.

articles.title: College sticker prices keep rising. Why many schools are still under financial strain
articles.description: Even with soaring price tags, a growing number of private colleges are in financial distress.

articles.title: Trump's America-first world is pushing other powers to hedge their bets
articles.description: Xi, Putin and Modi meet in New Delhi as U.S. tariffs, sanctions and the Iran war test whether BRICS members can find more common ground.

articles.title: Buffett's confidence in troubled decade-old acquisition finally pays off
articles.description: Warren Buffett has said he paid too much for Precision Castparts in 2016. Now its complex metal castings are in high demand.

articles.title: Tehran won’t surrender to the U.S., Iranian President Pezeshkian says, as India's Modi urges dialogue and peace
articles.description: On his first visit to India, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said he will not surrender to the U.S. and Israel, as New Delhi renewed its appeal for peace.
